title: How AI Assistance Affects Human Skill Development: A Study of Learning with Logic Puzzles
abstract: arXiv:2608.23543v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: While AI assistance can improve human task performance in the short term, it may also undermine the development of skills in the longer term. We examine this tension in a controlled logic-puzzle experiment involving on-demand AI assistance, where participants complete tasks before, during, and after AI is available. By experimentally varying AI request costs, we find that lower-cost assistance induces more frequent AI use. We also find that participants who request AI assistance during the AI-access phase perform worse at the task after assistance is removed, and their subsequent unassisted performance is overestimated when predicted from earlier AI-assisted performance. We use a Bayesian latent ability model to separate initial ability, post-AI ability, and participant-specific skill change, while estimating how independent reasoning during the AI-access phase relates to skill development. translated_title: 人工智能辅助如何影响人类技能发展：基于逻辑谜题的学习研究
translated_abstract: 摘要：虽然人工智能辅助能在短期内提升人类任务表现，但长期来看可能削弱技能发展。我们在一个受控的逻辑谜题实验中考察了这一矛盾，该实验涉及按需AI辅助，参与者在AI可用之前、期间和之后完成任务。通过实验性地改变AI请求成本，我们发现较低成本的辅助会导致更频繁的AI使用。我们还发现，在AI辅助阶段请求AI辅助的参与者，在辅助移除后的任务表现更差，且其后续无辅助表现若从早期AI辅助表现预测，会被高估。我们使用贝叶斯潜在能力模型来分离初始能力、AI后能力和参与者特定技能变化，同时估计AI辅助阶段的独立推理与技能发展的关系。结果表明，更多的独立问题解决与技能发展正相关。
tldr: 本研究通过逻辑谜题实验发现，低成本AI辅助虽提升短期表现，但会削弱长期技能发展，且AI辅助阶段的表现会高估后续无辅助能力。
en_tdlr: This study, using logic puzzle experiments, finds that low-cost AI assistance boosts short-term performance but undermines long-term skill development, and AI-assisted performance overestimates subsequent unassisted ability.
